blind_spots.blind_spot: ColdCloud is marketed as 'datacenter-ready' with 96-99.9% uptime assuming continuous facility power/cooling/staffing.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A forward or classified government facility isn't a commercial datacenter — no guaranteed continuous power, no on-call facilities team, and physical/TEMPEST security requirements that a 'centralized plant' cryogenic architecture never addresses.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team is optimizing for national-lab and commercial quantum customers, not DoD facility constraints.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Zero mention of ITAR, export control, CMMC, or NIST 800-171 anywhere on the public site despite holding an active AFRL SBIR Phase II contract for RF cable production.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A company already handling DoD-funded cryogenic RF hardware needs CMMC/NIST 800-171 posture before follow-on contracts can flow — silence here is the same blind spot that kills a Phase II-to-Phase III transition.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company language is 100% aimed at commercial quantum-computing customers (QuantWare, national labs), not government contracting officers.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: The quantum infrastructure company... more accessible, reliable, and affordable

blind_spots.blind_spot: "Three-year comprehensive warranty with same-day response" assumes a commercial support model (ship a tech, phone support) rather than sustainment planning for a device installed at a secure or overseas government site.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Same-day response and spares logistics collapse the moment the unit sits behind a SCIF door or on a base with restricted access — no GFE integration or field-service planning is mentioned.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Support model was designed for university/commercial lab customers who can grant vendor access on demand.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Three-year comprehensive warranty with same-day response

opener_hook: Maybell's AFRL SBIR Phase II (FLAX RF ribbon cables) and new ColdCloud platform are public — neither the product pages nor the LinkedIn about page mention CMMC or ITAR posture.
what_they_do: Builds dilution refrigerators and cryogenic infrastructure (ColdCloud) for quantum computing labs and data centers, with one AFRL SBIR-funded RF cable line item.
